entries.46ccfb2825126622: An electronic measuring instrument manufacturer established in 1954 in Meguro-ku, Tokyo, as Omatsu Denki Co., Ltd. Its head office is in Kohoku-ku, Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, and it is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market. As of March 31, 2026, consolidated employees numbered 127, and there are six consolidated subsidiaries, including sales subsidiaries in the United States, China, South Korea and the United Kingdom, a development and manufacturing subsidiary in the United Kingdom, and a domestic AI subsidiary.

entries.6ff5b96fb5e56f7a: This is a single-segment business that develops, manufactures and sells electronic measuring instruments. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,247 million. Its strengths lie in video-related fields, led by high-definition imagery for television and film. It handles measuring instruments for broadcasters, measuring instruments for development and maintenance by professional video equipment manufacturers, and signal-monitoring instruments for sports event broadcasts, among others. It sells globally through sales subsidiaries in the United States, China and South Korea and a development and manufacturing subsidiary in the United Kingdom.
